name: Wax Seal
summary: A one-time code written on a letter that tucks into an envelope and gets a wax seal
about: The 4-digit code is written in ink on a letter that sticks out of a kraft envelope. When the right code is entered the letter slides in, the flap folds down and a red wax seal with a check is stamped on. Good for login checks, email confirmation and two-step verification screens.
how: Type, paste or autofill the demo code on the letter; backspace and arrow keys move between digits
Each digit appears with a small ink blot and a solid underline
With the right code the letter tucks into the envelope and the flap closes
A wax seal with a check mark stamps onto the flap to show you are verified
A wrong code smudges the ink red, shakes the letter and clears it
